scope.request: Repeat FU-01 with current bounded journal and paired shared Editor; separate lifecycle and Editor work; recalculate conditional crossover.
scope.runs: One Splinter A/B cohort, then one shared-Editor cohort on byte-identical source and initial Library. Historical FU-01 comparison is not an isolated journal-only effect.
scope.work: Same A Increment +1 to +2 and B Double to Triple edits; explicit refresh, loaded values, new MVID/generation, selected assets/render hashes; shared baseline recompile.
scope.end: Parallel checkpoint --release preserving independent results, merge to separate ref, Library byte-identical restore before shared cohort; shared source/metadata restoration and owned worktree/Editor cleanup.
scope.exclusions: No Play/tests/game build, OS cache clearing, long-task benchmark, storage/RAM benchmark, package/service/global configuration change, source product optimization, forced process termination or unrelated resource cleanup.
scope.failure: Preserve evidence and exact task/request identity. Inspect returned recovery action; never automatically repeat uncertain mutations. Report recovery separately from normal throughput.
scope.temporaryLocalGitConfig: Same FU-01 core.autocrlf=input setting only in fixture repository, restored after Splinter closure; no global setting change.
scope.attempt: Final measured cohort, after diagnostic renderer assertion and Unity preferences-modal recovery
scope.renderAcceptance: Same source and asset identity/dependency fields; actual per-request PNG hash and valid visible render. Record historical/current cross-run pixel variation separately, without treating PNG byte equality as a universal render contract.

timingBoundary.shared: Parallel worktree creation + union of candidate edit/preservation + uninterrupted original Editor workflow + independent merge + worktree reclamation. AI reasoning, read-only input/final verification, build/tests excluded.
timingBoundary.overlap: A/B wall intervals counted once; Editor shutdown is included in combined completion.

limits: One ordered Splinter then shared cohort; OS caches are not cleared, no repetitions or randomized order.
FU-01 historical comparison changes current implementation and any recorded Library differences; not an isolated bounded-journal causal percentage.
No long workload, Play, Unity tests, game build, combined-result compilation, memory or storage-peak benchmark.
Crossover assumes unchanged additional lifecycle cost and a chosen per-task duration multiplier; the measured tiny-compile multiplier is not a long-task forecast.
Shared Editor normally regenerates Library cache; original tracked source, configuration, preexisting refs and worktrees are preserved.

diagnosticOutcome.reason: Historical render pixels differed; A/B current renders matched. During normal parallel completion Unity B showed a CanvasesSaveData.asset access-denied modal. A exited; one UI Try Again let B exit normally; identical B checkpoint/release resumed after EditorStopTimeout.

diagnosticPopup.action: One Try Again click via Computer Use

responseSchemaValidation.priorHarnessError: Initial selector included an array of discovery responses; corrected object-only input without changing responses.
